description: A lab-local path traversal: the file download endpoint serves paths outside the intended directory without normalisation.

evidence.notes: Lab-local fixture traffic only; /lab/secret.txt is a lab stub file outside the download directory
evidence.response: 200 OK, the contents of /lab/secret.txt in the response body

impact: An attacker could read arbitrary lab files through the download endpoint.
proof_of_concept: GET /lab/download?file=../../../../lab/secret.txt returns the file contents, which live outside the download directory.
remediation: Normalise the requested path and reject any path that escapes the download directory.
steps_to_reproduce: Open the lab file download endpoint
Observe the file contents in the download response
title: Path traversal in lab file download
